fields.description: The rule's identity and its match (ADR-0031): a Frappe filter over the record's fields (e.g. status,=,Overdue). Repeating an app/default rule's condition targets that rule; a new condition adds a rule. Blank is the catch-all.
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: The pill text. Leave blank only on a hide row.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The pill color token (e.g. green, orange, gray). Defaults to gray.
fields.label: Color

fields.description: Hide the matching app/default rule (a tombstone) instead of adding or replacing one — the site-wide equivalent of a personal hide (ADR-0031). The source rule is left untouched.
fields.label: Hidden
